native_trace.association: One exact target launch per replay call; report sidecar A/B/C/D GPU addresses are joined to every packet by audit_stream. CPU payload storage addresses are not used as GPU pointers.

limits: Finite retained X and exact-zero DY require numerical zero DW; output words are classified in the declared BF16 or FP32 encoding, counting every subnormal.
Complete retained backing hashes and exact original/prepared/current equality do not certify transient internal device operand reads.
Report sidecar A/B/C/D device pointers join every native packet; CPU failure storage addresses are not GPU addresses.
Saved failure DW matches the first retained CPU observation exactly; there is intentionally no independent later GPU reread agreement claim.
Raw FP32 export represents even original M rows only; its BF16 carrier statistics are not the numeric output statistics.

Direct accumulator export bypasses computed alpha/LDS-scale/bias values numerically, although those instructions execute. It observes through VGPR moves, output stores and a CPU copy; nonzero export does not uniquely identify WMMA as faulty.
Separate static candidate review binds the direct accumulator source and unchanged output store path; transient register delivery or output-path faults remain possible.
Both donor arms derive from the reviewed B-reuse-off direct accumulator export. Passing intermittent arms alone do not prove a fix.
Original versus modified ELF differs in the frozen patch; this auditor verifies owned image identity, not a specific corrupting instruction.
